official_sources.title: Boeing Supplier Cybersecurity
official_sources.bounded_signal: Boeing identifies NIST/ISO-aligned cybersecurity practices for suppliers; Defense & Space materials identify NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3, Boeing cybersecurity supplement SP5, FAR 52.204-21 and DFARS 252.204-7012 among relevant requirements.

official_sources.title: Boeing Terms Clause Index — Section M
official_sources.bounded_signal: Boeing publishes M201-M204 clauses for CMMC Level 1 Self, Level 2 Self, Level 2 C3PAO and Level 3 DIBCAC states; actual applicability is solicitation/contract-specific.

official_sources.title: BDS Terms and Conditions Guide A001
official_sources.bounded_signal: When specified CMMC clauses are incorporated, Boeing requires the applicable current CMMC level report from SPRS for award eligibility; where DFARS 252.204-7012 and/or -7020 apply, bidder cyber representations and Boeing C-SCRM assessment requirements may apply.

official_sources.title: Boeing ESLC External User Guide
official_sources.bounded_signal: The supplier lifecycle process includes CMMC-related supplier information; if a company states an assessment is complete, supporting certificate/date information is requested.

official_sources.title: Boeing Supplier Principles — Cybersecurity
official_sources.bounded_signal: Boeing expects suppliers to adopt industry-leading cybersecurity practices; this general expectation does not itself establish a particular contract's CMMC/CUI requirements.
